title: Let's Build Something Great
lead: Send us the problem, not a polished brief. Describe the process you want to automate or the product you want built, and we will come back with a straight assessment: what is worth doing, what it takes, and whether we are the right team for it.
secondaryParagraph: Every enquiry is read by an engineer. There is no qualification script and no obligation — plenty of first conversations end with us pointing someone at a simpler answer.

callout.after: and pick a slot that suits you.
